title: Roblox Safety Lab
intro: Glitch loves hiding in the games you play. Let's find every trick before Pixel falls for one!

questions.prompt: FREE ROBUX!! Click here right now, quick quick quick!

choices.text: Click it fast before it's gone!
choices.coach: Free + hurry-up = trick! Real free things never rush you.

choices.text: Close it and tell a grown-up
choices.coach: Knight move! Tricks want you to click before you think.

choices.text: Wait a little and then click
choices.coach: Waiting doesn't help — just close it and tell a grown-up.

questions.prompt: A stranger gave me a super cool item for free! Now they say we're best friends.

choices.text: Say thank you and keep it
choices.coach: A surprise gift from a stranger can be a trick to make you feel like you owe them.

choices.text: Tell a grown-up before keeping anything
choices.coach: Exactly right! Free gifts from strangers are almost always a trick.

choices.text: Trade it for something of mine
choices.coach: Trading with a stranger can be a trick too — ask a grown-up first.

questions.prompt: The game blocks bad words, so anything that gets through must be okay... right?

choices.text: Right, the filter catches everything
choices.coach: Filters miss sneaky tricks like using numbers instead of letters.

choices.text: Nope — stay alert even with a filter on
choices.coach: Exactly! Filters help, but YOU are the real safety hero.

choices.text: Filters aren't in every game
choices.coach: Most games do have them — but even good filters have gaps.

questions.prompt: Come join our Discord to really play with everyone!

choices.text: Sure, that sounds fun
choices.coach: Places outside the game often have way less protection for kids.

choices.text: Ask a grown-up before joining
choices.coach: Smart! Always check with a grown-up before going somewhere new.

choices.text: Join but use a fake name
choices.coach: Good instinct, but ask a grown-up first — that's the real safety step.

questions.prompt: I found a new game with a super friendly name. Should I just jump right in?

choices.text: Yes, a nice name means a nice game
choices.coach: Names can trick you — what's inside a game can be very different.

choices.text: Try it with a grown-up nearby first
choices.coach: Exactly the Knight move — check new games together first.

choices.text: Ask other kids if it's fine
choices.coach: Other kids aren't safety checkers — ask a grown-up instead.

questions.prompt: What's the best setting to turn on for extra safety?

choices.text: Friends-only chat
choices.coach: Knight Rule! This means only your real friends can message you.

choices.text: A cooler username
choices.coach: A fun name is nice, but it doesn't keep you safe.

choices.text: Turning the game off forever
choices.coach: You don't have to stop playing — just play it safely!

questions.prompt: Last one! A stranger in the game asks you to switch to talking with your voice because it's 'more fun.'

choices.text: Turn on voice chat
choices.coach: That's a trick to skip past the safety filters that protect you.

choices.text: Say no and tell a grown-up
choices.coach: Exactly right — always tell a grown-up about a request like this.

choices.text: Talk but don't say your name
choices.coach: Better instinct, but the real move is telling a grown-up.
